written: 2026-09-25 19:40 KST, after Stage 0, before Stage 1 predictors and before any merge evaluation
validation: full GLUE validation (mnli = validation_matched), no cap
metric: accuracy for every task (CoLA accuracy, not MCC; MRPC/QQP accuracy, not F1)
lam_selection: argmax over lam of mean(merged/single) on seed-0 1000-example TRAIN subsets; ties -> smallest lam
loto_rule: >= 6 of 7 leave-one-task-out rho > 0.3 (keeps the pre-registered >= 75% fraction, rounded up)
card_rule_note: Applied literally as instructed: a single-adapter full-val score > 2pp below the model-card number flags INVALID. The statistical verdict is reported separately.
sign_conflict_definition: TIES trim: keep top-20% |dW| entries per flattened task vector; fraction of jointly kept coordinates with opposite sign
bootstrap: task-block, 2000 reps, seed 0; reps with < 4 distinct pairs skipped
permutation: task-label permutation of D, 10000 random reps (seed 0); exact enumeration over 7! = 5040 also reported
exploratory_extra: validation scores at all 4 lam (not used for selection); n_layers_theta_min_lt30, min theta_min, untrimmed sign conflict, norm ratio (uncorrected)
